source.inspectionScope: Fresh complete74-line two-file patch read plus all four actual signing/symbol-policy review rows. Original four32/64 opt/debug attributes and denylist policy inspected; current32-bit keys removed and current upload kind delegates filtering differently. No full task generation, symbol upload or crash stack verification.

text:
commit af9afe299e3089e8cef2c686f6c6efa005870345
Author:     Rob Lemley <rob@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Thu Mar 27 17:27:57 2025 +0000
Commit:     Rob Lemley <rob@thunderbird.net>
CommitDate: Thu Mar 27 17:27:57 2025 +0000

    Bug 1942707 - Enable debug symbols upload for linux32/64 try builds. r=thunderbird-build-system-reviewers,coreycb
    
    Note that symbols upload is already enabled for macOS and Windows.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D242181

diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/build/linux.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/build/linux.yml
index e2fdf5a7f2e..c7e60b60d4a 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/build/linux.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/build/linux.yml
@@ -28,6 +28,8 @@ linux64/opt:
     index:
         product: thunderbird
         job-name: linux64-opt
+    attributes:
+        enable-full-crashsymbols: true
     treeherder:
         platform: linux64/opt
         symbol: B
@@ -86,6 +88,8 @@ linux64/debug:
     index:
         product: thunderbird
         job-name: linux64-debug
+    attributes:
+        enable-full-crashsymbols: true
     treeherder:
         platform: linux64/debug
         symbol: B
@@ -323,6 +327,8 @@ linux/opt:
     index:
         product: thunderbird
         job-name: linux32-opt
+    attributes:
+        enable-full-crashsymbols: true
     treeherder:
         platform: linux32/opt
         symbol: B
@@ -381,6 +387,8 @@ linux/debug:
     index:
         product: thunderbird
         job-name: linux32-debug
+    attributes:
+        enable-full-crashsymbols: true
     treeherder:
         platform: linux32/debug
         symbol: B
diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/upload-symbols/kind.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/upload-symbols/kind.yml
index 70947c78d89..57b7a8e0300 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/upload-symbols/kind.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/upload-symbols/kind.yml
@@ -14,13 +14,10 @@ kind-dependencies:
     - build
     - toolchain
 
-only-for-build-platforms:
-    - linux64-shippable/opt
-    - linux-shippable/opt
-    - macosx64-x64-shippable/opt
-    - macosx64-aarch64-shippable/opt
-    - win32-shippable/opt
-    - win64-shippable/opt
+not-for-build-platforms:
+    # Address Sanitizer builds don't have symbols to upload.
+    - linux64-asan-reporter-shippable/opt
+    - win64-asan-reporter-shippable/opt
 
 tasks:
     upload-symbols:
title: Bug 1942707 - Enable debug symbols upload for linux32/64 try builds. r=thunderbird-build-system-reviewers,coreycb
